description: Land Acquisition - Kawattiya, Rambukkana D/S Division, Kegalle District
categorisation: This gazette content is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act. It specifically describes the government's intention to acquire several plots of land (with detailed descriptions including lot numbers, land names, types, claimants, and extents) for a public purpose. The notice falls under "PART III – LANDS" and involves land acquisition procedures, which directly aligns with Type 4 (Land Gazettes) for land and property-related matters.
